name: bergbot-media
title_zh: 只给链接不给图，每条标注日期和第三方来源
tagline_zh: 想要某条知名路线的照片和故事？它不搬运内容，只给你官方页面、图库、近期游记和视频的链接，每条都带日期和第三方标记。
tagline_en: For photos/stories of one famous route: it returns dated, third-party links to official pages, galleries, recent.
desc_en: Photos and stories for a well-known route (official page, gallery, recent trip report, video) — links only, dated, marked third-party. Use when the user asks for photos/stories/images of the route.
why_zh: 它把「找资料」和「信资料」分开：链接可溯源、日期可排序、第三方身份明确，让你自己判断可信度。
why_en: Separates discovery from trust: every link is source-tagged and dated, so you judge credibility yourself instead of relying on.
limit_zh: 只覆盖一条知名路线，且只输出链接不输出内容本身。若路线不在其内置清单内，或你需要图片/文字摘要，它不会生成。
limit_en: Covers only one known route, outputs links only—no inline content. If the route isn't in its built-in list, it won't improvise; it'll tell you to.
title_en: Links only, no images, each dated and marked third-party
